import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlBu_r', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=50)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(occupation_activity)), occupation_activity.values, 
                      color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(occupation_activity))))
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity Level by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(occupation_activity)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_activity.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)

# 3. BMI Category distribution with Sleep Duration
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_palette = {'Underweight': '#FFD700', 'Normal': '#90EE90', 'Overweight': '#FFA500', 'Obese': '#FF6347'}
for bmi in bmi_order:
    bmi_data = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(bmi_data, bins=15, alpha=0.6, label=bmi, color=bmi_palette[bmi])
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend(title='BMI Category', fontsize=10)

# 4. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps by Gender
genders = df['Gender'].unique()
colors = {'Male': '#1f77b4', 'Female': '#ff7f0e'}
for gender in genders:
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 0].scatter(gender_data['Daily Steps'], gender_data['Heart Rate'], 
                       alpha=0.6, s=40, label=gender, color=colors[gender])
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(fontsize=10)

# 5. Stress Level by Age Group
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                         labels=['15-25', '26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
stress_by_age = df.groupby('Age Group')['Stress Level'].mean()
axes[1, 1].plot(stress_by_age.index, stress_by_age.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, color='#8B0000')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(stress_by_age.index, stress_by_age.values, 
                        alpha=0.2, color='#8B0000')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Stress Level Trends by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Sleep Disorder prevalence by Occupation
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    disorder_by_occupation = sleep_disorder_data.groupby(['Occupation', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    disorder_by_occupation.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 2], 
                                colormap='tab20c', width=0.8)
    axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 2].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
    axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
else:
    axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data Available', 
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
